problem: Multi-hop QA requires precise reasoning with entity relations at every step; existing models either predict sequential relation paths (hard to optimize) or aggregate hidden graph features (lacks interpretability).
method: TransferNet unified framework for label and text relations; jumps across entities at multiple steps; at each step attends to different parts of the question, computes activated scores for relations, and transfers previous entity scores along activated relations in a differentiable way, enabling effective and interpretable multi-hop reasoning.
key_assumptions: Relation-level attention and transfer can capture multi-hop reasoning effectively.
Unified handling of label and text relations improves coverage.
main_contribution: TransferNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-hop QA datasets, with 100% accuracy on 2-hop and 3-hop MetaQA, and provides transparent intermediate results via relation attention and transfer mechanisms.
results: ["TransferNet surpasses state-of-the-art models by a large margin; achieves 100% accuracy on 2-hop and 3-hop MetaQA."]

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: TransferNet focuses on relation-aware jumping and attention-based transfer, while the idea enriches target triples with local context subgraphs from source passages, adds an adaptive repair loop for factual reliability, and applies RL transfer from lower-hop QA.
